en.quote: Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts, saying, Execute true judgment, and shew mercy and compassions every man to his brother:
en.riddle: Execute true judgment, and show mercy and compassion.
en.speaker: the LORD of hosts

he.quote: כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת לֵאמֹר מִשְׁפַּט אֱמֶת, שְׁפֹטוּ, וְחֶסֶד וְרַחֲמִים עֲשׂוּ אִישׁ אֶת-אָחִֽיו
he.speaker: אֲדֹנָי צְבָאוֹת
